## Feel at home

**Word Power 30 · English idioms**

### Meaning

To feel comfortable and relaxed.

### Usage

1. By the end of the week she was beginning to feel at home in her new job.
2. He feels very at home in maths.

### Your turn

Use “feel at home” in a sentence of your own. The original lesson image also includes Hindi support and illustrations.
